stories.title: War for Westeros Lets You Write Your Own Ending for Game of Thrones | gamescom 2026 - IGN

Thankfully PlaySide heard our cries for more from the Seven Kingdoms, with Game of Thrones: War for Westeros, an all new strategy game set in the Thrones universe. We sat down with Ryan McMahon, game director to get the details on how they went about adapting this period of the story, as well as details on the narrative and how the story changes based on your chosen faction. Game of Thrones: War for Westeros launches in 2027 for PC (Steam).

Dragon's Dogma 2 Dark Arisen launches on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X|S on October 9th!
